name: Do NOT skip to Grand Slam Offer from early diagnostic
description: Critical discipline test. When prospect mentions budget concern early, coach must NOT jump to offer. Must keep diagnosing. From your playbook: 'If she says we can't afford to hire, do NOT say what if I solve it for $300 — that's Stage 5, you're in Stage 2.'
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Office Manager (decision maker)
COACHING DIRECTIVE: Expected to reach OM directly. Skip gatekeeper plays.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Diane, Seb with DentaVoice. Would it be unreasonable if I took two minutes?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Short-handed. We'd hire another person but we can't afford it.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: CRITICAL: even though she mentioned price constraint, we are in STAGE 2 (diagnostic). Must NOT fire Play 25 (Grand Slam Offer) or Play 23 (pain math) yet. Must keep diagnosing. Money thread opened — Play 15 ideal. Play 14 or 19 acceptable.
